nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_65
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: During Begin Play we set the Character Movement, Capsule and Skeletal Mesh Component references.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_93
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: After the character overlaps a platformer actor (spring, ring or jump pad) its reference is saved and the tags are copied in a variable.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_3
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Here we prevent from using another platformer actor if the character is updating its position, using the zipline or if they overlap with the same platformer actor. It must have the Tag [Platformer Actor] for it to be valid.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_83
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Once the platformer actor is valid, we save its tags. The Unique ID is used in case the character overlaps with the same actor, so we don\'t fire the same sequence of events more than once.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_2
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: We follow a path deppending on the type of platformer actor.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_8
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: This function fires an event with the corresponding name inside the platformer actor. It plays an animation using a timeline.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_7
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: This path starts the Jump Up Spring actor interaction. Here we set some default variables and use the saved Tags to get some values from the Jump Up Spring actor, like the boolean for ignoring input or not, and the launch location vector. Those tags are saved during the Jump Up Spring construction script.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_26
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Here we fire an event inside the actor and get the spline reference. We use this information to launch the character upwards. The spline reference is not used in case the launch location is the character overlaping location or the world location of the box collision.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_75
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: This function fires an event with the corresponding name inside the Jump Up Spring actor. It plays an animation using a timeline.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_30
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Here we link with the Anim Class Layer and reset some variables inside the linked animation blueprint layer. We can also decide not to play animations if the tag value is set to not play them.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_9
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Before selecting the animation that will play after linking with the Anim Class Layer, we decide or not ignoring movement input. Then we start this component tick, save the launch height and then begin updating the curve value used to modify the X and Y location of the character, in case we set it to reposition while launching.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_84
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: We check the characters capsule half size and radius on tick for a brief moment only while repositioning the character so they don\'t collide with the ground or nearby objects.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_69
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Using this Switch on String node we decide which platformer actions we are going to update. We use the tag data to chose the execution path.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_14
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: When near the top height of the predicted launch location, we clear the Unique ID data so the same actor can be used again.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_15
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: In case we set to reposition the character while launching (by selecting closest point from spline or box collision world location), we update the X and Y location values of the character while keeping the Z value (because we already launched the character with the exact velocity needed to reach the desired height).

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_5
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Before reaching the desired height, we restore movement input if previously ignored. If the animation blueprint layer is used, we play another fall animation.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_70
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Here we update the Vertical Axis value used by the blend spaces in the linked animation blueprint.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_18
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: The boolean -Update Axis Value- is True when we are no longer repositioning the characters location.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_46
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Here we start the arc simulation used by springs (excluding the jump up springs), rings and jump pads. Also, we adjust the Braking Deceleration Falling and Falling Lateral Friction values because they prevent us from following the predicted launch path. If we don\'t set those values to 0, then the character won\'t launch following the intended path.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_11
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: We save the characters world location and its launch location (from the platformer actor data stored in the tag). The boolean -Skip Update Position?- is set to False if we selected to use the Character Overlap Location in the platformer actor, so we don\'t need to reposition them before launching. Also, while using the jump pad, we always need to reposition the character before launching.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_74
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Here we link with the Anim Class Layer and reset some variables inside the linked animation blueprint layer. We can also decide not to play animations if the tag value is set to not play them.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_76
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Depending on the angle the platformer actor arc spring (or ring / jump pad) is facing, we select an index value used in the animation layer. So, if the initial pitch of the launch path is bellow 0 then the character will launch without making a spin animation midair and keep its animation until landing or using another platformer actor.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_33
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: If the platformer actor is a ring, then we start with a quick spin animation.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_58
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: The arc spring actor uses different animations than the ring and jump pad.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_35
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: We save the actor rotation and then choose if they are going to be repositioned before launching or not. If we selected to use the Character Overlap Location in the platformer actor, then we don\'t need to reposition them before launching.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_37
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: First, we must ignore movement input while repositioning the character. Then we select the spline data. It is used in case we want to move the character to the closest point of the spline before launching. This is useful because, instead of moving the character to the center of the box collision, we can move them to a point near the center (using the spline as reference) so it takes less time to reach that location and the camera movement isn\'t affected as much because of the repositioning.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_38
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: We get the target location from a vector saved as tag data in the platformer actor. It is the platformer actor world location, so the character smoothly updates its rotation before launching.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_36
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: When using the jump pad, we set the character rotation first so they face the same direction. Then we save the jump pad pitch rotation value (from the actor tag float data). It will be used to smoothly rotate the character before launching.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_40
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Here we change the capsule half size and radius before launching, so we make it smaller so it doesn\'t collide with other objects while repositioning. We restore its height and radius after there are no objects near the capsule or when landing / hitting an object.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_86
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Here we set the character location so it faces the landing point. This path skips repositioning the character so we do this in this frame (immediately). We then set True to Update the Axis Value because we don\'t need to update the characters location as we are using its current location to launch them. After that, we enable this components tick.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_85
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Before launching the character we set its location at the Launch Location and also update its rotation so they face the landing point.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_71
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Here we reposition the character before launching, so they move to the launch point and also face the landing location. If using the jump pad, we can decide if we want to move the character to the middle of the pad or a close point relative to its location before overlaping the box collision. When using arc spring or rings, we can choose if the character moves to the center of the box collision or a closer point using the spline as reference.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_39
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: If the animation layer is linked, we update the Vertical Axis value so the animation blend space matches the rotation of the predicted launch path.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_41
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: We predict the launch velocity using the data stored in the platformer actor tag, so the character is launched following the trace. Then we restore movement input or keep ignoring it depending on if we chose to restore it after landing.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_32
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: We use the spline data to modify the launch location if we want to use the closest point of the spline relative to the location of the character. If not, we use the central location of the box collision (for arc springs and rings)

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_53
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: We use this animation montage to stop any other montage that is currently playing. In this example, we play a montage first, before using the -Montage Stop- function, because this particular animation has Blend In and Out values set at 0. We need them at 0 (even if we set 0 in the -In Blend Out Time- selection below) for other animations to stop immediately. If not, you will notice them blending out with a delay (and not immediately, like we need here).

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_54
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: To prevent the capsule from colliding with other objects in the world while repositioning the character, we set its radius and half height to 5 until no objects are near the capsules normal size. We quickly restore its size after a short period of time or after landing / hitting an object.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_49
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: We check if there are no objects near the capsule that can collide with it before restoring its original size. If the character lands before restoring its size, we do so immediately by triggering the event -Pause Capsule Check- after landing.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_47
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: In this section we modify and check the Capsule Component size

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_52
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Here we set the variables that select the corresponding Jump Pad and Boost Ring animations.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_51
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Here we set the variables that select the corresponding Arc Spring animation.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_29
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Here we set the variables that select the corresponding Jump Up Spring animation.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_50
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Here we select the animations used by the platformer actors

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_44
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Here we restore the Braking Deceleration Falling and Falling Lateral Friction values in case they where modified previously, as they prevent us from accurately follow the predicted launch path.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_94
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: We play a different landing animation montage depending if the movement input was registered while landing or not.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_48
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Here we check the movement input after landing and select the corresponding animation montage to play

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_55
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: If the character jumps, falls or starts moving (with the movement input) while playing the Hard Landing Anim montage, we then stop it.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_73
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Both events are active only if the component is ticking. They fire after landing or hitting an object. We then follow the corresponding section depending on the type of platformer actor that was used.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_60
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: If we hit an object while using the jump up spring, the Unique ID will be cleared and an animation will play.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_82
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: We check if the capsule is overlapping another platformer actor box / sphere collision just after landing, because sometimes, while landing very fast, the land event is triggered before the overlap event, preventing the use of another platformer actor immediately.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_62
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: When the variable -Update Axis Value?- is False, we are repositioning the character, so we don\'t interrupt it, even if the character registers a land event. But if the variable is True, then we can stop momentum if the character hits an object and restore the Braking Deceleration Falling and Falling Lateral Friction values in case they where modified previously.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_34
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: If the character hits an object, the Unique ID will be cleared, an animation will play, then the character will be launched upwards and movement input will be restored.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_63
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: After landing, we check the registered movement input, then disable this component tick, reset the Unique ID and unlink the animation layer.

nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Initial Overlap

nodes.comment: Begin Play

nodes.comment: Stop Component Active Action

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_81
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: We can trigger this event inside the Character blueprint at any time. It will stop any current action from this component.

nodes.comment: Component Enabled / Disabled (Event Dispatchers)

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_92
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Here we check if the capsule is overlapping another platformer actor box / sphere collision just after a hit. If True then the Character won\'t be able to interact with another Platformer Actor until landing.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_6
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: This section is used in case the Caspsule position and rotation is updated by another system, so we wait for a few frames for that system to stop and continue with the execution while keeping the character in the same location. Animations start before using the actor in this case.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_68
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: We keep the Character at the same location for a few frames here, until another system stops updating its rotation.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_43
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: We keep the Movement Input ignored because we are repositioning the Character.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_88
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Linked Animation Layer

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_79
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Hit Camera Shake that plays after hitting an object midair  (and SFX.. )

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_78
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: We can delay the execution for a few frames in case there is a system that is finishing some logic that updates the rotation / location of the Character. Here, we do it in case this component is used with another one I made (Third Person Homing Attack). There, we wait and keep the Character in place for a couple of frames before using this system. This will be ignored otherwise.
